prompt: Add pagination to GET /users: query parameters limit (default 20, at most 100) and offset (default 0), both non-negative whole numbers. Anything else (a negative, non-numeric or too-large value) is a 400. The response body becomes { users, total }, where total is how many users match the filter before paging. Do the paging in src/db.js, not by slicing in the API layer.
